      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Separating kernel sources and paring down utility dependencies advances the core work of removing node dependencies from kernel code. The author notes that this 'completes the internal library design as laid out in doc/design/libraries.md' and facilitates cleanly compiling the external kernel library alongside internal dependents."
